blogPosts.title: Top Signs Your Bentleigh Home Needs a Switchboard Upgrade
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the warning signs that indicate your Bentleigh switchboard is outdated and why upgrading is crucial for safety and compliance.
body: The switchboard is the heart of your home's electrical system, and in Bentleigh, many older properties still have original boards that lack modern safety features. An outdated switchboard can't handle the demands of today's appliances, leading to frequent overloads and safety hazards. If you're experiencing issues like tripping circuits or discoloured outlets, it might be time for an upgrade to protect your Bentleigh home and family.

Common signs that your Bentleigh switchboard needs replacing include the presence of ceramic fuses, lack of safety switches (RCDs), or a board that's more than 20 years old. These older boards often have limited capacity and don't comply with current Australian standards, which require RCDs for all power and lighting circuits. In Bentleigh, where homes range from period houses to modern builds, ensuring your switchboard is up to date is essential for insurance and safety.

Upgrading your switchboard in Bentleigh involves installing a new board with multiple circuits, circuit breakers, and RCDs to provide better protection against electrical faults. This upgrade not only prevents electrical fires but also allows for future additions like air conditioning or solar systems. The cost typically ranges from $800 to $2,500, depending on the complexity and any rewiring needed, making it a valuable investment for Melbourne suburbs with varying electrical demands.

Bentleigh's climate, with its hot summers and cool winters, puts additional strain on electrical systems as heating and cooling appliances run frequently.
